user.title: Kinetic Voice Router
user.description: Adds the Kinetic Voice Router (version {version}) and connects it to your Hermes Agent Companion. The connection is tested before anything is saved. The router only handles requests that Home Assistant did not process locally and never controls devices. It starts in mode "Off". **Experimental software, no warranty.**

data_description.url: Address of the Hermes Agent Companion, e.g. http://host:8765 (LAN or VPN only; HTTPS recommended).
data_description.token: Token of the Hermes Companion. It is stored in the Home Assistant configuration and never shown or logged.
data_description.verify_tls: Keep enabled. Only disable for a self-signed certificate in a trusted network.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Hermes Companion
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to the Hermes Companion needs to be set up again (for example a rejected token, or an update from an older version). Enter URL and token; they are tested first.
